Container.Name: reality
Container.Overview: Shared Prague property shortlist: listings pushed by n8n, star ratings and comments in SQLite, live updates in the browser.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port the board is served on. Point the reverse proxy here.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: SQLite database (ratings, comments) and the current feed.json.

Config.Name: Ingest token
Config.Description: Long random string. n8n sends it as 'Authorization: Bearer ...' when pushing the feed.

Config.Name: Users
Config.Description: Comma-separated names for the 'Rating as' picker. Ignored when a user header is set.

Config.Name: SSO user header
Config.Description: Optional, e.g. X-authentik-username. Only set this if the port is reachable solely through the proxy.

Config.Name: Feed poll interval (ms)
Config.Description: How often to check feed.json for changes made outside the API.
